title: OpenAI offers 100,000 academic researchers free access to frontier models
friendlyTitle: OpenAI will give free advanced AI access to 100,000 researchers
summary: OpenAI is starting a programme that will give 100,000 eligible scientists, mathematicians and engineers free access to frontier ChatGPT and Codex tools through 2027. It begins with 10,000 researchers and includes larger context windows, research connectors, training and business-grade data protections.
friendlySummary: Eligible university researchers can apply for free access to powerful ChatGPT and Codex tools. The programme starts with 10,000 people and plans to grow through 2027.
whyItMatters: The programme could widen access to costly research tools for literature review, analysis, coding and hypothesis development. Researchers still need to validate outputs, document AI assistance and check institutional eligibility and data-governance requirements.
friendlyWhyItMatters: More researchers may use advanced AI without paying for it. They must still check results and follow their institution’s rules.
